about: Word meanings from Simple English Wiktionary and English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) and AlloFlow school vocabulary, word families from Open English WordNet 2025 (CC BY 4.0) and Princeton WordNet 3.1 (WordNet License).
